items.title: Stay Ahead of Ransomware: From Takedowns to Hacking Back
items.summary: Join us for the October 6th episode of Stay Ahead of Ransomware as co-hosts Ryan Chapman and Mari DeGrazia welcome special guest Mr. Bihms (FOR528 Alpha participant) to explore how the ground is shifting under cyber extortion groups. We'll trace the lineage of high-impact disruption—from landmark actions like Operation Cronos and Operation Endgame to recent Treasury OFAC sanctions targeting crucial infrastructure like bulletproof hosting and VPN providers. Then, we’ll dive into the groundbreaking August 12th White House memorandum and what it means for private sector entities engaging in offensive security operations against foreign cybercrime threat groups. Bring your questions and join the debate on the potential pitfalls, benefits, and ripple effects of "hacking back" in today's threat landscape! Guest Name: Joseph Bihms Title: Threat Hunter Bio: Joseph Bihms is a DC-based threat hunter with 11+ years in security operations at both Fortune 500 and privately held companies. His work centers on adversary profiling, hypothesis-driven hunts, and turning telemetry into actionable detections. GREM and GCFE certified; FOR528 Alpha participant.
